dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Ah, lekker! Look at those lights go!

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Now that I can see properly, I can hear it too. There's a pipe leaking somewhere behind these walls.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Find the wall where the bricks are exposed and give it a knock to listen for where the pipe's hiding.

dialogueItems.name: Nomsa
dialogueItems.text: Once you've found it, get in there and fix it up properly.
